PlayerId.description: Assigned by the lobby service on create or join. Lowercase UUID v4.

SessionId.description: Assigned by the lobby service when the host starts a session. Lowercase UUID v4.

LobbyCode.description: Human-friendly lobby identifier players type to join. 6 characters, no ambiguous letters or digits.

PlayerToken.description: Opaque secret returned once on create or join. Sent as the X-Player-Token header. Never shown to other players.

Slot.description: Seat index in the lobby, 0-based. The host is slot 0. Clients map slots to avatar colors.

WorldSeed.description: Non-negative 31-bit integer so it fits a signed 32-bit int in every stack.

ContentId.description: Identifier for data-driven content: resource types, node types, structure types, objectives. Lowercase kebab-case. Open set: new values are added in the world config, not in schemas.

EntityId.description: Identifier for an instance in the world: a resource node (tree-0042) or a placed structure (structure-3).

Timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date-time in UTC with a Z suffix.

Vec2.description: Point on the ground plane in meters. See docs/conventions.md for axes.

Vec3.description: World position in meters. Y is up.

Yaw.description: Rotation about +Y in radians, normalized to [-PI, PI]. 0 faces -Z.

ResourceAmounts.description: Map from resource type to a non-negative whole amount. Keys are resource types declared in the world config rules. Missing keys mean 0.

Problem.description: Error body for every REST service, following RFC 9457 (application/problem+json) with a required machine-readable code.

title.description: Short human summary. Stable per code.

detail.description: Human explanation of this occurrence. Safe to show in the UI.

code.description: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE error code. Open set: clients must handle unknown codes by showing detail or title.

errors.description: Field-level validation failures. Present only with code VALIDATION_FAILED.

field.description: JSON Pointer or dotted path to the field.

contractsVersion.description: Value of contracts/VERSION this build implements.
